sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Procedure for authorising expenditure from the Consolidated Fund
maudhui: (1) The President shall direct the persons concerned to prepare and lay before Parliament in each financial year estimates of the revenue and expenditure of the Government of the United Republic for the following financial year. (2) When Parliament has approved the estimates of expenditure, other than expenditure charged upon the Consolidated Fund by this Constitution or any other law, a Bill to be known as an Appropriation Bill shall be introduced in Parliament to authorize withdrawal from the Consolidated Fund of the sums necessary to meet that expenditure. (3) If in any financial year it appears that the amount appropriated for a particular purpose is insufficient or expenditure is required for a purpose for which no amount has been appropriated, or money has been spent in excess of the amount appropriated or for an unappropriated purpose, supplementary estimates or, as the case may be, a statement of excess expenditure shall be laid before Parliament; after approval, an Appropriation Bill shall be introduced to authorize the necessary withdrawal from the Consolidated Fund.

(3) If in any financial year it appears that the amount appropriated for a particular purpose is insufficient or expenditure is required for a purpose for which no amount has been appropriated, or money has been spent in excess of the amount appropriated or for an unappropriated purpose, supplementary estimates or, as the case may be, a statement of excess expenditure shall be laid before Parliament; after approval, an Appropriation Bill shall be introduced to authorize the necessary withdrawal from the Consolidated Fund.
